The Bound Atlas

the whole atlas on one sheet

The atlas of The Isle of Rahai is bound: 14 plates, the chronicle and the gazetteer, from the proof on the desk.

bound in 12s

Contents of the atlasa thumbnail turns the sheet

  1. iThe chart, drawn in the antique manner
  2. iiOther draughtings: topographic, pen & ink, nautical
  3. iiiThematic surveys: vegetation, temperature, rainfall, population
  4. ivRegional surveys: The Environs of Laukuwelua, The Environs of Toatauhe
  5. vThe prospect of Laukuwelua
  6. viThe banners of every realm · 3 arms
  7. viiThe chronicle · 8 entries
  8. viiiThe gazetteer · 26 places
